title: Crossover from subcritical to critical decay: random walk, self-avoiding walk, percolation
summary: The study of the Ornstein--Zernike decay of subcritical two-point functions in equilibrium statistical mechanics has a history going back over a century. Despite this, the crossover from Ornstein--Zernike decay to critical power-law decay has received scant attention in the literature. We prove a general theorem which, under appropriate hypotheses, identifies the asymptotic behaviour of the solution to an Ornstein--Zernike equation on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ as that of the Green function for Brownian motion with drift, multiplied by an anisotropic exponentially decaying factor.
